title: Ye De Ming Ming Shu
synopsis: After a difficult upbringing, Qingchen's life takes a drastic turn when a mysterious countdown emerges on his arm. He is taken to Prison No. 18, a dangerous parallel universe, when it reaches zero. He overcomes severe adversity and gains the respect of the demigod Li Shutong by using his cunning and bravery. He then becomes his disciple and embarks on a journey of genuine transformation.

titleRomaji: Wo Zai Feitu Shijie Sao Laji
synopsis: Zhu Ning, a warrior who slayed in all directions in a zombie apocalypse, unexpectedly dies and is transported to a wasteland filled with unknowns and fantasy. She becomes a fifth-class citizen, the lowest rank in the world, forced to make a living by "scavenging garbage." However, she discovers the strangeness and danger of this world in her work: various bizarre polluting monsters, the world's strange operating rules, and even her own strange self… Zhu Ning gradually uncovers a huge secret hidden behind the world, which also brings her immense danger. In this unknown post-apocalyptic world, Zhu Ning is forced into complex conflicts, searching for the truth about herself and the world. (Source: Bilibili, translated)
